items.title: Migrate authoritative survey requirements from input-documents into traceable ROS work items
Canonical survey domain contracts and F# module boundaries
items.description: Define the canonical template, instance, response, submission, group, result contracts, invariants, and implementation boundaries.

items.title: Template authoring, publication, versioning, and compatibility
items.description: Implement draft authoring, validation, canonicalization, hashing, immutable publication, lineage, compatibility, localization, accessibility, and rollback/supersession workflows.

items.title: Answer model, URL encoding, and live respondent lifecycle
items.description: Implement typed answer states and selectors, deterministic compact encoding, portable submission envelopes, live URL synchronization, resume, integrity, and explicit decode errors.

items.title: Identity, anonymity, roles, and group semantics
items.description: Implement identified and anonymous identities, unlinkable finalization, respondent/subject/role boundaries, group configuration, counts, and privacy invariants.

items.title: Deterministic rules, validation, flow, completion, and recommendations
items.description: Implement the shared typed rule model, dependencies, branching, derived facts, validation, completion, and recommendation evaluation.

items.title: Scoring engine, result semantics, and explainability
items.description: Implement standard and parameterized scoring, constrained custom expressions, section/survey/group result shapes, versioned semantics, diagnostics, and explicit error handling.

items.title: Administrator import, aggregation, and report-state persistence
items.description: Implement accepted-submission import, deduplication, SurveyResult and SurveyGroupResult aggregation, AdminReportState projection, and embedded/external persistence.

items.title: Reporting contract, privacy, comparisons, and renderers
items.description: Implement versioned report definitions/data, audiences and blocks, privacy suppression, comparisons, localization, exports, snapshots, and deterministic renderers.

items.title: Cross-cutting test, performance, security, migration, and acceptance program
items.description: Establish characterization, contract, property, compatibility, URL-budget, cross-device, privacy, security, explainability, and migration acceptance tests.

items.title: Reconcile current Echelon engineering capabilities
Align verification with current Echelon capability contracts
Administrator application state, group management, and Limen UX
items.description: Build the administrator application lifecycle, group management, information architecture, Limen boundary, saved analysis, capability explanations, and operational diagnostics.

items.title: Storage provider contract and GitHub repository provider
items.description: Define the provider-neutral storage contract and implement the GitHub repository provider, manifest, integrity, rate-limit/scale behavior, and provider conformance.

items.title: Administrator import, concurrency, durable aggregation, and indexes
items.description: Implement import intake, idempotent concurrent acceptance, OutcomeUnknown reconciliation, immutable accepted results, incremental aggregation, and rebuildable indexes.

items.title: Administrator analytics, comparisons, lineage, and dependency invalidation
items.description: Implement deterministic analysis/statistics, semantic comparisons, drill-down, lineage, change impact, semantic diffs, and end-to-end dependency invalidation.

items.title: Typed visualization grammar, dashboards, and accessibility
items.description: Implement the typed visualization grammar, chart suitability validation, accessible rendering semantics, responsive dashboards, and visualization regression verification.

items.title: Report builder, snapshots, exports, configuration packages, and policy packs
items.description: Implement report authoring/versioning, immutable snapshots, exports, portable configuration packages, and reusable versioned policy packs.

items.title: Administrator privacy, security, audit, retention, and deletion lifecycle
items.description: Implement disclosure controls, differencing protection, no-PII audit, storage security constraints, retention/archive/delete semantics, and privacy policy enforcement.

items.title: Storage migration, backup, schema evolution, and operational recovery
items.description: Implement provider migration, backup/restore, schema adapters, degraded/read-only recovery, and operational health diagnostics.

items.title: Administrator sandbox, synthetic data, advanced analytics extensions, and phase boundary
items.description: Implement isolated simulation, seeded synthetic/adversarial data, preserve phase-1 no-server scope, and keep future probabilistic analytics non-authoritative.

items.title: Administrator cross-cutting verification, performance, and acceptance program
items.description: Gate administrator delivery with stress, property/model-based, provider, accessibility, privacy, resource-limit, migration, and incremental-equivalence verification.

items.title: Finalize Echelon Signal current ROS, Ordo SDE, and Limen baseline
items.description: Upgrade current main from ROS 3.1.3 to 3.1.4 and Limen 0.6.1 to 0.6.2, enforce strict SDE verification, and define Signal's explicit F# and browser Limen boundaries without replaying legacy migration state.

items.title: Complete scoring and selector requirements catalog
items.description: Audit and complete basic/moderate scoring methods and closed-ended selector/question contracts, with explicit web-component handoff and no-PII constraints.

items.title: Attribute scoring and selector completeness branch diff
items.description: Bind the complete main-to-branch scoring/selector requirements diff to durable ROS completion provenance after incremental repository commits.

items.title: Prepare Signal implementation baseline
Resolve Limen 0.7.0 LIMEN012: no engine source under src/Echelon.Signal.Engine, so strict verify is not-configured (exit 8)
Replace limen.config.json boundary.notApplicable with engine/kernel paths (src/Echelon.Signal.Engine, src/Echelon.Signal.Browser) when the first F# WASM engine source lands

Restore Aegis to required: true in .echelon/foundations.json, with EchelonFoundry.Aegis.Core, real boundary usage and aegis-boundaries.json, in the change that adds the first .NET/F# host or operational boundary (DF-SIGNAL-FND-2026-0001)
Restore Forma to required: true in .echelon/foundations.json, with the pinned @echelon-foundry/design-system, in the change that adds the first interactive browser surface (DF-SIGNAL-FND-2026-0001)
Restore Folio to required: true in .echelon/foundations.json, with the pinned @echelon-foundry/print-components, in the change that adds the first report or document output (DF-SIGNAL-FND-2026-0001)
